verdict: rep2 FAILED the same single gate: mixed_multivariate 0.006777 vs envelope 0.004522 (z +5.88); other 17 gates PASS (worst R-hat 1.0098, lambda_rep)
two_run_conclusion: two independent seed sets at z +2.86 and +5.88 rule out simple Monte Carlo luck at the pooled-gate level; per the preregistered rule the kernel is NOT validated and no larger run was launched

forensics.gate_reads_chains_0_and_1_only: the frozen estimator thins the chain-major pooled rows to 8000 and uses the FIRST 4000 — i.e. chains 0-1; true for 6E1B and 7B1 as well
forensics.localization: the failure is CHAIN 0 in both runs (same dispersed start, different seeds); our chains 1-3 (6 chains) are statistically indistinguishable from the passing 7B1 kernel's four
forensics.chain0_scalar_shifts: rep2 c0: beta -0.137 refSD (~5 SE at its ESS), lambda_rep -0.174 refSD (~6 SE) — concentrated in the early retained blocks (slow low excursion), consistent with its near-failing lambda_rep R-hat 1.0098; run1 c0 means are clean yet z +4.16, so the statistic also reads joint/temporal structure
forensics.slow_wander_is_universal: lambda_rep/beta block means wander comparably in ALL kernels' chains (ESS ~1300-2000 per 48k retained); the gate's iid-calibrated envelope does not account for this realization variance
forensics.stride_test: the pooled exceedance vanishes (z +0.4/+0.2) when the MCMC rows are re-thinned to cover all 4 chains at double spacing, in both runs
forensics.everything_else_clean: marginals, dependence structure (correlation parity vs reference at 7B1's level), ESS profile identical to 7B1, exact tiny-space stationarity 2.2e-16

unresolved: why BOTH of our chain 0s (same start, different seeds) are the two most extreme z's out of 12 chains while 7B1's chain 0 is clean: either realization luck on a slowly-wandering coordinate the gate reads with only 2 chains, or a real start-region-linked interaction of the collapsed move with the scalar updates
recommended_next_probe_user_decides: 4 fresh-seed chains of the SAME kernel, ALL from dispersed start[0], registered length (~3 h wall): if their z's scatter like 7B1's the two failures were realization luck; if they land high consistently, the kernel mistreats that start's basin and the bug hunt is warranted
not_done: no long run launched, no threshold touched, no gate re-rolled
